select bc1.coupon_name, ccr.card_number, ccr.card_id, if(isnull(bc.sold_date) , null, bp.name) as buyer, bp1.name as activator, IFNULL((SELECT sum(a.current_amount) FROM coupon_change_record a
a.card_id = ccr.card_id
AND a.occur_date = (select max(occur_date) from coupon_change_record where date_format(occur_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{query.startDate} AND card_id = ccr.card_id)
GROUP BY a.occur_date LIMIT 0,1), 0) as beginDeduction, IFNULL((SELECT sum(a.occur_amount) FROM coupon_change_record a
a.occur_type = 2 and a.card_id = ccr.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT(a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d") BETWEEN #{query.startDate} AND #{query.endDate}
),0) AS thisDeduction, IFNULL((SELECT sum(a.occur_amount) FROM coupon_change_record a
a.occur_type = 3 and a.card_id = ccr.card_id
and DATE_FORMAT(a.occur_date, "%Y-%m-%d") BETWEEN #{query.startDate} AND #{query.endDate}
),0) AS thisDeductionRefund, IFNULL((SELECT sum(a.current_amount) FROM coupon_change_record a
a.card_id = ccr.card_id
AND a.occur_date = (select max(occur_date) from coupon_change_record where date_format(occur_date, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{query.endDate} AND card_id = ccr.card_id)
GROUP BY a.occur_date LIMIT 0,1), 0) AS endDeduction from coupon_change_record ccr inner join base_card bc on bc.card_id = ccr.card_id inner join base_coupon bc1 on bc1.coupon_id = ccr.coupon_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = bc.buyer_id left join base_patient bp1 on bp1.patient_id = bc.patient_id
`ccr`.`coupon_id` in
#{item}
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%')) or (`bp1`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
group by ccr.card_id,ccr.patient_id

select cci.coupon_name as couponName, c.card_number as cardNumber, c.sale_channel_name as saleChannel, dip.package_unit_price as saleAmount, bti.item_name as itemName, cb.item_type, count(*) as quantity, bp.name as patientName, b.bill_num as billNumber, date_format(cb.use_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `billDate`, bo.abbreviation as orgName, be.employee_name as executorName from base_benefit cb inner join base_card c on cb.card_id = c.card_id inner join base_coupon cci on c.coupon_id = cci.coupon_id left join deduction_item dip on dip.item_id = cb.item_id and dip.coupon_id = cb.coupon_id and dip.type = cb.item_type left join base_coupon_order_virtual cov on c.card_id = cov.card_id left join base_bill b on cb.order_id = b.bill_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = cb.patient_id left join base_employee be on be.user_id = cb.operate_user_id left join base_tariff_info bti on bti.item_id = cb.item_id AND bti.item_type = cb.item_type left join base_organization bo on bo.org_id = cb.org_id where cb.coupon_type = 5
and (cb.use_date >= #{query.startDate} and cb.use_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and `c`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`product_type_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{query.couponName}, '%')
and `c`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{query.cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
and `cb`.`org_id` in
#{item}
and dip.crt_time = (select max(crt_time) from deduction_item where coupon_id = cci.coupon_id and crt_time <= ifnull(c.sold_date, c.active_date)) group by cb.card_id, cb.order_id, cb.item_id,cb.item_type order by cb.use_date desc

select bp.name as buyer, bp.mobile, cov.coupon_name, cov.card_number, date_format(cov.sold_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as buyDate, cov.order_sn as orderNumber, group_concat(cbbp.account_item_name) as accountTypeName, bo.abbreviation as orgName, cov.price, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, be.employee_name as operateName from base_coupon_order_virtual cov inner join base_coupon cci on cov.coupon_id = cci.coupon_id left join base_patient bp on cov.patient_id = bp.patient_id left join base_coupon_bill cb on cb.order_id = cov.order_id left join base_organization bo on bo.org_id = cb.org_id left join base_coupon_bill_pay_detail cbbp on cbbp.order_id = cov.order_id left join base_employee be on be.user_id = cb.checker_id
and (cb.bill_date >= #{query.startDate} and cb.bill_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and `cci`.`product_type_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{query.couponName}, '%')
and `cov`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{query.cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
and `cb`.`org_id` in
#{item}
group by cov.order_id, cov.card_id

select cov.coupon_name, cov.card_number, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, crd.refund_amount, group_concat(distinct cfp.account_item_name) as refundType, bo.abbreviation as orgName, be.employee_name as executorName, cr.refund_reason as remark from base_coupon_refund_detail crd inner join base_coupon_refund_pay cfp on cfp.refund_id = crd.refund_id inner join base_coupon_refund cr on crd.refund_id = cr.refund_id LEFT join base_coupon_order_virtual cov on cov.virtual_id = crd.order_virtual_id left join base_coupon cci on cci.coupon_id = cov.coupon_id left join base_employee be on be.user_id = crd.executor_id left join base_organization bo on bo.org_id = cr.org_id
and (cr.refund_date >= #{query.startDate} and cr.refund_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and `cci`.`product_type_id` in
#{item}
and `cci`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{query.couponName}, '%')
and `cov`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{query.cardNumber}, '%')
and `cr`.`org_id` in
#{item}
GROUP BY crd.refund_id
